findings.label: Template initialization race condition
findings.description: The page_rules() function loads templates at render time from db_adapter.get_rule_templates(), but the dq_rule_templates table is seeded only during _init_local_db(). If a user lands on the page before the DB is initialized or if the table is empty, template tiles won't render. Verify DB init happens on first app load.

findings.label: Missing Callback 3 default_threshold reference
findings.description: In the Template Tile Click callback (Callback 3), the code accesses tmpl_row['default_threshold'] but the dq_rule_templates table schema (line 94 in db_adapter.py) does not include a default_threshold column. The column exists in rule_engine.py's RULE_TEMPLATES dict but is never persisted to the DB. This will cause a KeyError at runtime when a user clicks a template tile.

findings.label: Search term handling in Configured Rules table
findings.description: The refresh_configured_rules_table callback applies search filtering but does not clear the input when project/dataset changes. If a user searches for a term and switches projects, the old search term persists, potentially showing an empty table even though rules exist in the new project. Should clear the search input or add it to Input dependencies.

findings.label: Audit log serialization incomplete for complex types
findings.description: The log_config_audit function's safe_serialize() converts non-JSON-serializable values to strings, losing structural information in the audit trail. If a threshold is a numpy int64 or complex nested structure, the audit loses type context. Should use a custom JSON encoder or pre-convert pandas/numpy types.
